programme.title: From Darkness
programme.desc: Park ranger Angelica is tasked with leading the search for a missing woman in a remote Swedish reserve known for treacherous terrain. Acknowledging the risks, she seeks help from Viktor, her former boyfriend and a skilled dog handler. The case forces them back into a landscape marked by shared trauma: two years earlier, they failed to find a missing child there, a loss that fractured their relationship. As they follow traces through dense forest and unstable cave systems, they confront a longstanding legend of a spirit blamed for drawing wanderers and miners to their deaths. Fatigue, guilt, and isolation test Viktor’s sense of reality. To uncover what happened, they must navigate both the dangers of the wilderness and the unresolved weight of their past.

programme.title: Meat Kills
programme.desc: Hoping to prove herself to Animal Army, a militant activist organization led by the uncompromising Nasha, Mirthe secretly documents the grim reality inside a pig farm. Her evidence secures her place in the group and inspires a planned rescue mission, but when the activists return at night, the cages stand empty—the pigs killed before they could be freed. Enraged, Nasha pushes the group toward retaliation, targeting the farmer and anyone in their path. When the farmer discovers the intrusion, a violent confrontation erupts, leaving Mirthe caught between Nasha’s destructive vengeance and the farmer’s desperate attempts to protect his family. As the conflict escalates, Mirthe must decide what she is willing to do to survive the bloodshed.
